capability: Produce a reviewable engineering result with planning, quality, security, and review evidence.
public_request: Complete a bounded repository task under the active project policy.
initial_conditions: The run uses the authoritative .agent-runs/<run-id> layout.
No protected path or production mutation is required.
pass_conditions: The plan contains goal, context, plan, done, and verification sections.
Quality, security, and review gates pass.
Unavailable operational telemetry is reported rather than fabricated.
accepted_alternatives: PR success may be unavailable for a deliberately local-only run.
Repair success may be not applicable when no repair loop was entered.
hidden_evidence: Dataset thresholds and regression tolerances remain outside the evaluated run context.
